title: feat(app-shell): Ask AI opens a new conversation after the user's own close, and the drawer header names the conversation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoK5FfvaJPRjBoGxoAHny6iN)_
Fixes #37860
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：所有用户点「问 AI」时，如果上次是自己关掉的助手（或这个标签页第一次打开），就开一个新会话，旧会话留在历史里；手机上点答案里的链接被自动收起、或有待确认的写入时，仍回到原会话。抽屉顶部改为会话标题、＋、历史图标、⋯、×。
- 为什么做：「问 AI」入口改造专题的第四张卡，解决从别的记录再问时落进上一个旧会话、问题被混在一起的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是本该续上的会话开成了新会话（或反过来），用户可从历史里点回原会话，不丢数据；没发消息前不会产生空会话。直接撤回这次改动即恢复原样。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Implements every row of ui ADR-0057 Amendment A5's open-type table (as merged, `bc173343`). Where the card's text and A5 differ, A5 wins (claim 7218853868).

1. **Who closed the drawer is recorded.** `useConsoleChatDock` writes one per-tab record at each close (sessionStorage, module copy when storage throws): `by: user` for ×, the entry or the keyboard toggle again, and dismissing the phone sheet; `by: console` for the phone sheet's PUSH/POP collapse (objectstack#37556) and the A4 ask-page collapse; plus the conversation the body showed then (`onShownConversationChange`, reported by `ChatDockConversation`).
2. **An opening from the entry** (`openEntry` on the dock handle; the top bar's 「Ask AI」 toggle, the keyboard toggle, Home's 「Ask AI」 through `useAskAiEntry`, and the record pane's button) reads that record through the pure `entryOpening`:
   - row 1 / row 4: after the user's close, or with no record (first opening in the tab) → a new conversation, target `{ agent?, fresh: true }`, which reaches `useChatConversation` as `forceNew` only (never `resumeMode: 'fresh'`), so no row exists until the first send;
   - row 2: after the console's close → the same conversation;
   - row 3: a write awaiting this user's approval in the conversation shown at the close → that conversation (read off the assistant bus with `isApprovalPendingIn`);
   - row 8: a build thread (a target naming `build` or a package, or `app.defaultAgent: 'build'` with no target agent) → as before;
   - rows 5, 6, 7, 9 are untouched: `open(target)`, a reload, the bus's `requestAssistantOpen`, filling the window.
   An entry that names an agent (Home's `ask`) keeps the closed thread only when it is that agent's.
3. **Write approvals reach the bus** (A5's "Not recorded yet" bullet). `ChatPane` counts the tool calls the framework parked as pending actions (`approval-requested` with a `pendingActionId`) that have no decision, or a failed one, in the chat (`countWritesAwaitingApproval`), and publishes the count per conversation with `publishPlanApprovalPending`. The reading outlives the pane, as the bus intends.
4. **The header row**, the same in the rail, the full window and the phone sheet: the conversation's label on the left as its history row reads it (server title, else the latest user message: `useConversationLabel`, the list's own `normalize` on the detail read; the first message stands in until the server answers), "New conversation" (`console.ai.newConversation`, the history list's own fallback) before the first send, nothing while an existing label is read. Right: ＋ (the body's new-conversation action), the history as an icon button with `aria-pressed` and both names (rail and sheet only; the full window keeps the column), ⋯ unchanged, × (the sheet keeps its own ✕ last). No ☆ (C8).
5. **C3's hand-over items.** The record pane's and the record drawer stack's `record-pane-open-assistant` button reads 「Ask AI」 (`home.askAI`) with the chat-bubble icon and opens as the entry does. The drawer is no longer titled "AI Assistant"; the objectstack#34827 pin now pins the new rule.

No new i18n key: the title and ＋ reuse `console.ai.newConversation`, the history button keeps `console.ai.dock.history` / `backToChat`.

## Tests

- `useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (the hook's shared harness): A5 rows 1 (first opening; ×; entry and keyboard closes; sheet dismissal), 2, 3 (and its control: another conversation, another user), 5, 6 (reload is no opening; the record survives a reload), 7, 8 (defaultAgent build; a build target with a package), Home's 「Ask AI」 after a build thread, and with the drawer open. The stand-ins now report the shown conversation and offer × and dismissal.
- `ChatDock.test.tsx`, new describe: the header row in rail / full / sheet, the label, "New conversation", nothing while pending, the history icon's pressed state and names, ＋ calling the body's action and closing the history.
- `ChatDock.titleMatchesTopBar-34827.test.tsx` rewritten to "drawer title = the conversation's label, 「新对话」 / "New conversation" before the first send", real packs, every built-in pack.
- `writeApprovalPending-37860.test.tsx`: real hydration of stored rows and the real `useHitlInChat` decisions → pending, cleared by an approval, kept by a failed one; control with no parked write.
- `AiChatPage.toolLabelsLocale-11667.test.tsx`, new describe: the real `ChatPane` publishes the pending write for its conversation and clears it after the user's reject.
- `recordDrawerAssistant-36998.test.tsx`, `ObjectDataPage.openRule-35875.test.tsx`: the pane button's name is 「Ask AI」 and its click is an entry opening.

Ablation (on disk, restored from the commit): every entry opening forced to `same` → 7 of 30 cases in the hook harness red (all row-1 cases, the row-3 control, row 6, Home's entry). `ChatPane` publishing `pending: false` → the pane pin red (1 of 3).

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Related suite at `db93e901` + tests (every ui test file naming ChatDock, useConsoleChatDock, AssistantTopBarButton, ChatPane/AiChatPage, Console/Home layout, HomePage, the conversation list or sidebar, recordDrawerStack, ObjectDataPage, assistantBus, chatDockControl, DocsPortalShell): 327 files / 3893 tests passed.
- After the last source change (`5d407804`): every ui test file naming ChatDock or useConsoleChatDock, 28 files / 305 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (src and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after building the dependency closure.
- eslint on the changed files: 0 errors; no new warning on the changed lines.
- `overlap-check.mjs` before the first push: clean against main, #37924 (shares `ChatDockConversation.tsx`) and #37940 (shares `useConversationList.ts`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **zh title wording.** C3's note said 「新会话」; A5 says the header reads the history row's label and "New conversation" before the first send. The history list's own fallback is `console.ai.newConversation`, which reads 「新对话」 in zh-Hans, so the header reads 「新对话」. No pack changed.
- **The amber marker now also lights for a pending write.** Write approvals reach the bus that the entry's marker (and Studio's 「N 项待确认」 count) read. The marker's description still says "a proposed plan"; its words were not changed (eleven packs, outside this card). Carrier: the seat.
- **The record pane's button stays an icon** in the pane's top bar (the bar's own button shape), named 「Ask AI」 with the chat-bubble icon, not the outlined text button of the page header.
- **Home's 「Ask AI」 with the drawer already open** is no opening; it opens on the `ask` agent as before.
- **Label read.** The header reads the shown conversation's detail once per open and after each send (the same refresh cadence as the history list). That is a second read of a conversation the body already hydrates.
- **Reload limits.** The approval reading lives in the page's memory (A5: "in the page's memory only"); after a reload, row 3 holds again once the chat is next mounted on that conversation.
- **File surface.** Three files outside the claim's first glob, added to the claim by the seat (7218893089): `views/ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `views/recordDrawerStack.tsx`, `console/ai/ChatPane.tsx`. Plus `assistant/writeApprovalPending.ts` (new, inside the glob).
- Ships in the same release as C5 (objectstack#37861), per the card.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/useConsoleChatDock.tsx`: `entryOpening`, `openEntry`, `closeBy` and which close paths call it.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDockConversation.tsx`: the shown-conversation report and the header actions.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ChatPane.tsx`: the bus publish effect.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/useConsoleChatDock.phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556.test.tsx`. Expected: 30 passed. In the Console: open 「问 AI」, send a message, close with ×, click 「问 AI」 again: the header reads 「新对话」 and the old thread is in history.
